thread:
Mira K: Quick heads-up — Aurora tenant private deploy scheduled Thurs 10:00am PT. Need to align network/egress owners, cert sync, image mirror status, and any air-gap blockers. Who's the firewall owner for this tenant?
AJ: I can own firewall. Which ports and CIDRs should I open?
Mira K: Thanks. Minimal ports we need:
````
- 443 (api)
- 5671 (message queue)
- 10250 (kubelet)
- 50051 (inference/grpc)
````
Also outbound to package mirror IP 52.23.11.44:443 and S3 for artifacts (arn:aws:s3:::redwood-artifacts).
Diego R: I'll take images/registry + mirror. Current sync is at 86% — ETA ~2h. Need the signed certs from security to push into the private registry.
Jess L: Security approved the certs yesterday. @Diego R I uploaded keys to Vault at `secret/tenants/aurora/certs`. Grant `read` to `aurora-deploy` role.
ops-bot: [deploy-bot] dry-run: aurora-staging dry-run started (no network errors yet).
AJ: For egress fallback, recommend a proxy at 10.1.12.5:3128. Who can spin that up?
Diego R: I can provision a small instance and stand up squid in staging. I'll open an infra CR today.
Mira K: Ownership snapshot: network: AJ; images/registry: Diego R; certs/audit: Jess L; canary owner: Mira K. QA/product not yet pinged — will do after canary smoke.
Jess L: Also, audit wants syslog forwarded to splunk index `aurora-deploy`. AJ can you confirm we can forward 514/UDP?
AJ: Confirmed — will open firewall to 10.9.8.7:514/UDP and set syslog route.
Mira K: Current blockers: 1) images <100% 2) signed certs accessible in vault 3) tenant route not present on edge router. Status updates please.
Diego R: Images at 98% now. Two large layers failed checksum; re-triggering rsync with `--inplace` to avoid reupload. ETA 30m.
Jess L: Security confirms certs are minted and ACL'd to `aurora-deploy`. Diego, try reading from Vault when you have a sec.
Diego R: Pulled certs after I rotated token — fetch succeeds now.
Network-ops: Router team will inject BGP route at ~09:15 PT. Will post when route is visible.
Mira K: Proposed timeline: BGP by 09:15, images done by 09:30 -> canary start 10:00. If any of these slip, push to Friday. Objections?
AJ: No objections. I'll post firewall change window: 09:10–09:25.
Jess L: I'll coordinate audit log forwarding and retention policy.
Mira K: Quick ask — @Diego R can you paste the `docker pull` smoke command once rsync finishes so ops can validate image?
Diego R: Sure — smoke commands:
````
docker pull registry.internal/aurora/infra:canary-20260317
docker run --rm registry.internal/aurora/infra:canary-20260317 /bin/true
````
ops-bot: [smoke-test] staging smoke for canary image succeeded at 09:42 PT — exit 0, startup latency within SLOs.
Mira K: Great. I'll update the customer PM and mark status as "on track" for now. Thanks all :thumbsup:
